prompts.title: 沉思女性的电影感特写
prompts.description: 这是为 Gemini Nano Banana 编写的提示词，旨在生成一张电影感特写镜头：一位年轻女性躺在床上，神情忧郁，画面突出了她的服装细节（粉色罗纹高领毛衣）和配饰（金质结婚戒指、复古手表），并采用柔和的漫射光照明。
prompts.content: A cinematic, close-up shot of a young woman lying down on a bed, resting her head on her arm with a somber, pensive expression. She has dark hair and is wearing a dusty pink ribbed turtleneck sweater. Her hand is visible in the foreground, adorned with a simple gold wedding band and a vintage gold watch paired with metallic bracelets. The lighting is soft and diffused, casting gentle shadows across her face and highlighting the texture of the grey patterned bedding. The overall mood is quiet, intimate, and melancholically beautiful.

prompts.title: Elizabeth Olsen：田园风高级定制微距肖像
prompts.description: 这是一个为 Gemini Nano Banana Pro 设计的极具针对性且细节丰富的提示词，旨在创作一张酷似 Elizabeth Olsen 的超写实前卫微距肖像。主体身着一件完全由生玉米棒和玉米粒制成的不可思议的高级定制服装，强调极致的纹理细节、精准的美学布光以及锐利的眼神交流，并采用模拟胶片质感进行渲染。
prompts.content: The Intricate Macro Portrait: An extreme close-up shot of The Protagonist, exuding 'The Piercing Minimalist' energy with absolute, unblinking eye contact and a high-intensity stoic expression. The subject is engulfed in an impossible, avant-garde haute couture garment and wide-brimmed headpiece constructed entirely of raw, freshly husked ears of yellow corn and meticulously aligned individual kernels. The heavy, organic, surreal armor wraps tightly around the neck and frames the face, treated as a high-budget physical practical effect. Shot in a darkened botanical atelier against a deep, matte-black velvet backdrop to eliminate distractions. The face is fully illuminated with flawless Beauty Lighting—a large overhead beauty dish creates perfect catchlights in the sharply focused irises, while balancing a soft fill that highlights microscopic skin pores and the glistening, waxy texture of the corn kernels. Captured on a Hasselblad H6D-100c with a 120mm Macro lens shot at f/2.8, ensuring a razor-thin depth of field that makes the organic filaments, silks, and kernel reflections pop against a softly blurred, dark void. Kodak Portra 160 film stock emulation, authentic analog grain, profound tactile realism, completely devoid of neon or digital illustration artifacts. Frame: Portrait (4:5), extreme close-up, tightly framing the subject's face completely surrounded by the intricate organic corn textures. Center-weighted symmetry, drawing the viewer instantly to the eyes and the complex structural geometry of the garment. Directly at eye-level, highly intimate and confrontational. Subject: The Protagonist, serving as a universal fine-art archetype. Ageless, ethereal high-fashion model. Female with flawless but textured natural skin, neutral makeup, sharp jawline enveloped by the cowl. Hair completely concealed beneath the heavy, structural kernel headpiece. Only the face and a fraction of the neck are visible, bearing the physical weight of the surreal garment. Expression: Absolute stoicism, high-intensity neutral gaze, projecting quiet dominance. Wardrobe: Massive sculptural cowl neck and shoulder piece made from raw, whole ears of yellow corn stacked and woven densely together, complete with organic silk filaments. Vibrant, organic harvest yellow with pale earthy undertones. Suffocatingly tight, heavy, and architecturally structured around the chin and neck. Wide-brimmed domed hat in monochromatic golden yellow made from thousands of perfectly aligned, individual raw corn kernels acting as geometric beads. Surrealist Botanical Haute Couture style. Environment: A highly controlled, darkened botanical photography Atelier. Light-absorbing matte-black velvet backdrop directly behind the subject. Extremely shallow depth; the world drops off immediately into a pure black void behind the subject. Still, cool, devoid of ambient light, giving full control to the studio strobes. Lighting: Large overhead beauty dish with a diffusion sock (Paramount/Butterfly lighting) to evenly illuminate the face. Subtle silver reflector positioned under the chin to soften deep shadows cast by the heavy organic cowl. Barely perceptible cool edge light to separate the outer silhouette of the corn hat from the black background. Rich, deep, but retaining micro-contrast within the granular textures of the corn. 5500K (Daylight balanced to ensure accurate, true-to-life organic yellows and skin tones). Camera: Medium Format Macro Prime lens at 120mm, aperture f/2.8. Pin-sharp lock on the irises and the absolute nearest corn kernels framing the cheeks. Medium Format Digital simulating 120 film. Zero spatial compression, highly accurate true-to-life facial proportions. Post-processing: High color fidelity, rich organic saturation of yellows against absolute true blacks. High dynamic range with a distinct cinematic film curve, protecting highlights on the waxy corn. Pronounced analog film grain (Kodak Portra 160), emphasizing physical skin pores and plant cell structures. Zero artificial sharpening; relying entirely on the pristine optical clarity of the macro lens. Extremely subtle edge fringing in the deep out-of-focus areas to mimic vintage glass. Negative specifications: No neon lights. No digital 3D rendering or CGI look. No cartoonish or animated elements. No full body shots. No smiling or emotive facial contortions. No flat lighting. No artificial plastics or synthetic fabrics. No wide-angle distortion.
prompts.translatedContent: 精致的微距肖像：一张主角的极度特写镜头，散发着“锐利极简主义”的气息，眼神绝对专注且不眨眼，表情呈现出高强度的冷峻感。主体被包裹在一件不可思议的前卫高级定制服装和宽檐头饰中，这些服饰完全由新鲜剥皮的黄玉米棒和精心排列的独立玉米粒构成。沉重、有机且超现实的“盔甲”紧紧包裹着颈部并衬托着面部，呈现出高预算的物理实拍效果。在昏暗的植物摄影工作室中拍摄，背景为深哑光黑色天鹅绒，以消除干扰。面部被完美的美学布光（Beauty Lighting）完全照亮——上方的大型美容碟（beauty dish）在焦点锐利的虹膜中创造出完美的眼神光，同时平衡了柔和的补光，突显了微小的皮肤毛孔以及玉米粒闪烁的蜡质纹理。使用 Hasselblad H6D-100c 搭配 120mm 微距镜头，光圈 f/2.8 拍摄，确保了极浅的景深，使有机纤维、玉米须和玉米粒的反光在柔和模糊的黑暗虚空中脱颖而出。模拟 Kodak Portra 160 胶片质感，具有真实的模拟颗粒感和深刻的触觉写实感，完全没有任何霓虹灯或数字插画的痕迹。构图：肖像（4:5），极度特写，紧凑地框住主体面部，周围环绕着复杂的有机玉米纹理。中心对称，瞬间将观众的注意力吸引到眼睛和服装复杂的结构几何形状上。视线平齐，极具亲密感和对抗性。主体：主角，作为一种通用的艺术原型。年龄成谜、空灵的高级时装模特。女性，拥有完美但具有纹理的天然皮肤、中性妆容，下颌线锐利，被头罩包裹。头发完全隐藏在沉重的结构化玉米粒头饰下。仅露出面部和一小部分颈部，承载着超现实服装的物理重量。表情：绝对的冷峻，高强度的中性凝视，投射出一种安静的统治力。服装：巨大的雕塑感高领和肩部装饰，由生整玉米棒堆叠并紧密编织而成，配有有机的玉米须。充满活力的有机丰收黄，带有淡淡的泥土色调。在下巴和颈部周围紧绷、沉重且具有建筑结构感。单色金黄色的宽檐圆顶帽，由数千颗排列整齐的独立生玉米粒作为几何珠子制成。超现实主义植物高级定制风格。环境：高度受控的昏暗植物摄影工作室。主体后方为吸光的哑光黑色天鹅绒背景。景深极浅；主体后方的世界立即坠入纯黑色的虚空。静谧、凉爽，没有任何环境光，完全由摄影棚闪光灯控制。布光：上方大型美容碟配柔光罩（Paramount/Butterfly 布光），均匀照亮面部。下巴下方放置细微的银色反光板，以柔化沉重的有机头罩投下的深阴影。几乎察觉不到的冷色轮廓光，将玉米帽的外轮廓与黑色背景分离。色彩丰富、深邃，但在玉米的颗粒纹理中保留了微对比度。5500K（日光平衡，确保准确、真实的有机黄色和肤色）。相机：中画幅微距定焦镜头，120mm，光圈 f/2.8。焦点精准锁定在虹膜和勾勒脸颊的最前方玉米粒上。中画幅数码模拟 120 胶片。零空间压缩，面部比例高度准确且真实。后期处理：高色彩保真度，黄色在绝对纯黑背景下呈现出丰富的有机饱和度。高动态范围，带有独特的电影胶片曲线，保护蜡质玉米上的高光。明显的模拟胶片颗粒（Kodak Portra 160），强调物理皮肤毛孔和植物细胞结构。零人工锐化；完全依赖微距镜头原始的光学清晰度。深处失焦区域有极细微的边缘色散，以模仿复古镜头效果。负面要求：无霓虹灯。无数字 3D 渲染或 CGI 感。无卡通或动画元素。无全身照。无微笑或夸张的面部表情。无平光。无人工塑料或合成纤维。无广角畸变。
